title: Diamond Ghost Charters
specs: Fishing within 2-5 miles inshore and 8-15 miles offshore for salmon and lake trout
Licensed and insured charter boat with US Coast Guard licensed captain
Valid Illinois fishing license with Lake Michigan salmon stamp required for all persons age 16 or older
Maximum 6 passengers per boat as per Coast Guard regulations
Children under 5 years old not recommended; children under 10 should be accompanied one-on-one by an adult
Corporate and multiple boat trips available with $200 deposit per boat
includes: All fishing equipment including rods, reels, and terminal tackle
blurb: Guests fish for salmon and lake trout on Lake Michigan from a licensed charter boat. Trips range from 5 to 8 hours with a maximum of 6 passengers. All fishing equipment is provided on board at no extra cost.
extraNote: $150 deposit for 5 and 6 hour trips; $200 deposit for 8 hour trips; $200 deposit for multiple and corporate trips · Cancellation must be made 12 days or more before the trip to receive a refund · Deposits and balances paid with credit card include a 4% additional fee · North Point Marina, Slip AB20, 701 North Point Drive, Winthrop Harbor, IL 60096 · May through October
